videos.headline: Drake Maye throws INT, Virginia completes massive upset
videos.description: Virginia upsets No. 10 North Carolina on the road after Drake Maye throws an interception in the final minute.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Drake Maye throws INT, Virginia completes massive upset) 2023/10/21 ESHEET

videos.headline: Malik Washington forces his way into end zone to put Virginia ahead
videos.description: Malik Washington doesn't let multiple North Carolina defenders stop him from scoring a go-ahead touchdown for Virginia in the fourth quarter.
